Six comments

Jarl Hunter Of Gillaburn

This is a fine Shetland march composed by Alan Scollay.

I learned it in these keys from both The Elgin and Inverness Fiddlers. I think that this was how it was played originally.

However, “friendlier” possibilities exist as in this Jenny Wrigley performance.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CBXeWOkcEMA

I’ll maybe transpose the tune and/or post another setting in due course.

Please note that there is no repeat in the “F” part second time around in this setting but it’s up to yourselves, of course, if you want to change things.

In the meantime, enjoy….

↳ Posted by 🎻 Melody Player 🎻 on January 8th, 2022.
